# 社交媒体营销

## 概述

本章围绕社交媒体营销组织英语词汇，分为社媒平台词汇、营销策略、社群运营、数据分析四个部分。它解决的是在社媒推广中描述平台、策略和运营效果的问题，尤其关注营销动作与数据反馈的表达。每个部分配有听说例句与写作表达，适合营销沟通与方案撰写。建议把策略类词汇与数据分析术语结合学习，做到既讲清打法，又能用数据说明效果。

## 社媒平台词汇

| 词汇       | 词性 | 含义   | 常用搭配                              |
| ---------- | ---- | ------ | ------------------------------------- |
| platform   | n.   | 平台   | social media platform, cross-platform |
| algorithm  | n.   | 算法   | platform algorithm, algorithm change  |
| feed       | n.   | 信息流 | news feed, curated feed               |
| reach      | n.   | 触达   | organic reach, expand reach           |
| impression | n.   | 展示   | total impressions, impression count   |
| follower   | n.   | 粉丝   | gain followers, follower count        |

### 听说例句

> A: How is our organic reach on Instagram compared to TikTok? B: TikTok gives us 5x more impressions per post. The algorithm rewards new content more aggressively.

> A: Should we focus on follower count or engagement? B: Engagement. A smaller, engaged audience is more valuable than a large, passive following.

### 写作表达

- Cross-platform content distribution maximizes reach by adapting messaging to each platform's algorithm.
- Organic reach has declined on most social media platforms, making paid promotion increasingly necessary.

---

## 营销策略

| 词汇                     | 词性 | 含义         | 常用搭配                                      |
| ------------------------ | ---- | ------------ | --------------------------------------------- |
| influencer               | n.   | 网红/KOL     | influencer marketing, micro-influencer        |
| KOL (Key Opinion Leader) | n.   | 关键意见领袖 | KOL collaboration, top KOL                    |
| brand awareness          | n.   | 品牌知名度   | increase brand awareness, build awareness     |
| target audience          | n.   | 目标受众     | define target audience, reach target audience |
| viral                    | adj. | 病毒式传播的 | go viral, viral content                       |
| organic                  | adj. | 自然的       | organic growth, organic traffic               |

### 听说例句

> A: Should we invest in influencer marketing for this launch? B: Yes, micro-influencers in our niche have high engagement. They're more cost-effective than top KOLs.

> A: What's the goal — brand awareness or conversion? B: Brand awareness first. We want the content to go viral and reach our target audience organically.

### 写作表达

- Influencer marketing with carefully selected KOLs drove a 40% increase in brand awareness among the target demographic.
- Viral content amplified organic reach beyond expectations, generating 10 million impressions in the first 48 hours.

---

## 社群运营

| 词汇           | 词性 | 含义       | 常用搭配                                       |
| -------------- | ---- | ---------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| community      | n.   | 社群       | build a community, online community            |
| engagement     | n.   | 互动       | user engagement, boost engagement              |
| moderator      | n.   | 版主       | community moderator, moderate comments         |
| user-generated | adj. | 用户生成的 | user-generated content, user-generated reviews |
| sentiment      | n.   | 情绪/舆情  | positive sentiment, sentiment analysis         |
| loyalty        | n.   | 忠诚度     | brand loyalty, customer loyalty                |

### 听说例句

> A: How do we build a stronger community around our brand? B: Encourage user-generated content, respond to comments, and run weekly engagement activities.

> A: What's the overall sentiment from our recent campaign? B: Mostly positive. There's strong brand loyalty among our core community members.

### 写作表达

- Active community management and consistent engagement have cultivated a loyal and vocal customer base.
- Sentiment analysis tools help monitor brand perception and identify potential reputation risks early.

---

## 数据分析

| 词汇                     | 词性 | 含义     | 常用搭配                                  |
| ------------------------ | ---- | -------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| analytics                | n.   | 分析数据 | social media analytics, review analytics  |
| CTR (Click-Through Rate) | n.   | 点击率   | improve CTR, average CTR                  |
| bounce rate              | n.   | 跳出率   | reduce bounce rate, high bounce rate      |
| attribution              | n.   | 归因     | attribution model, last-click attribution |
| funnel                   | n.   | 漏斗     | conversion funnel, funnel analysis        |
| A/B test                 | n.   | A/B测试  | run an A/B test, A/B test results         |

### 听说例句

> A: What does our funnel analysis show? B: We're losing 40% between awareness and consideration. The CTR on our landing page is too low.

> A: Should we run an A/B test on the ad creative? B: Absolutely. Let's test two versions and measure which one reduces the bounce rate.

### 写作表达

- Funnel analysis revealed that optimizing the landing page CTR could increase overall conversions by 20%.
- The attribution model was updated from last-click to multi-touch to better reflect the customer journey across channels.
